messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Mutual action schedule — legal edit owners & SLA cadence

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier. Per our call, I attached a draft Mutual Action Schedule (MAP_EdgeHealth_v0.9.xlsx) with milestones pulled from today's discussion. The short version for legal redlines and SLA negotiation:

- MSA/DPA redlines: EdgeHealth legal to produce first pass redline by 2027-08-25 (Target: 7 calendar days).
- Redwood legal internal review: 48 business hours after receipt of your redline (internal SL: 2 business days).
- SLA negotiation: Parallel to redline — Tommy (cc'd) will own initial SLA items; Redwood to respond within 3 business days of receiving specific SLA comments.

Ownership (proposed):
- EdgeHealth: prepare and send official MSA/DPA redline (Tom/EdgeHealth Legal).
- Redwood (legal ops): Monica Patel will coordinate redline intake and produce tracked changes; Ben Carter will own commercial responses (pricing/credits).
- Redwood (product/infra): Marissa will validate any technical requirements called out in the SLA (data residency, logging).

Dependencies / risks:
- If EdgeHealth requests non-standard data residency or dedicated tenancy, that will add 2–3 weeks to the timeline and require an internal infra review (kickoff required).
- Any redline that changes our indemnity/limitation terms will need VP Legal approval and may extend turnaround.

Requested next steps:
1) Priya/Tom: confirm you can deliver the MSA/DPA redline by COB 2027-08-25.
2) Priya: flag any SLA items that are "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" so we can prioritize technical review.
3) Monica: I'll loop you in on tracking and set a 48h SL for initial Redwood internal edits.

Attachments: MAP_EdgeHealth_v0.9.xlsx (milestones), MSA_EdgeHealth_redline_v1.docx (seed doc), SLA_draft_EdgeHealth.pdf (SLA baseline)

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgehealth.com>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@edgehealth.com>, EdgeHealth Legal <legal@edgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 18:37:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mutual action schedule — legal edit owners & SLA cadence

Thanks Logan — good summary. I confirmed with Tom and our legal team: we can commit to an initial redline by 2027-08-25. A couple of clarifying points before we send:

- Our legal lead (Aisha Kumar) will focus on data handling clauses and indemnity language; she flagged the limitation of liability section as likely to be edited.
- For the SLA: we will mark two items as must-have (data retention window and audit log access). The rest will be negotiable.

We will upload the redline to the DocuSign link you provided and send a heads-up email to Monica once done.

On timing: if you can guarantee Redwood internal review within 48 business hours, we should be able to keep to a target close in early September — assuming no material escalations.

Best,
Priya
Director, IT Procurement | EdgeHealth
priya.shah@edgehealth.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgehealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mutual action schedule — legal edit owners & SLA cadence

Thanks Priya — appreciate the confirm. Quick operational notes from Redwood Legal: 

- Confirmed: Redwood will target 48 business hours for an initial marked-up response after we receive your DocuSign upload. We'll push for 48 business hours but will escalate to VP Legal if changes touch indemnity/limitations.
- Please put any "must-have" SLA items into the body of the DocuSign upload or as a short attachment so Marissa can triage them immediately for technical feasibility.
- If EdgeHealth intends to request custom encryption-at-rest beyond our standard KMS integration, flag that as it will need security review (estimated +5 business days).

Action owner table (tracking):
- EdgeHealth: submit MSA/DPA redline (owner: Tom / Aisha) — due 2027-08-25
- Redwood Legal: initial redline response (owner: Monica) — target 48 business hours after receipt
- Redwood Commercial: pricing/credits response (owner: Ben) — target 3 business days
- Redwood Product: technical verification of SLA items (owner: Marissa) — target 3 business days for triage, deeper review if flagged

I'll create a shared sheet and update the MAP milestones with these owners and due dates. Please reply if any of the owners above should be different.

Monica Patel
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Perfect — thanks all. Two small logistics notes before we close the loop:

1) Priya/Tom: when you upload the redline please include a short changelog (one paragraph) summarizing the major asks (indemnity, data residency, SLA).
2) Monica: please post the shared tracker URL once ready and set reminders for the 48h / 3d SLs so Ben and Marissa get notifications.

Target close: based on commitments above, pencil in 2027-09-07 as a target close date (contingent on no VP-level escalations). I'll update the MAP to reflect that tentative close.

Thanks — appreciate the quick cadence.

Logan
